latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editing with KineMaster — mobile video editing via text commands.

- Instantly edit and export mobile-shot videos by typing instructions (e.g., "trim the pauses, add transitions, and overlay background music").
- Automatic setup with one-click anonymous token and session management.
- Upload raw video clips and receive a 1080p edited MP4 file within minutes, processed remotely on GPU nodes.
- Supports simple project state management, credit balance queries, and error handling.
- No need for timeline dragging or export settings — streamlined for quick social or vlog content.
- Accepts major video, image, and audio formats up to 500MB per file.
